description: This file implements the GstDispatcherThread class responsible for handling GStreamer bus messages in a separate thread, managing state changes, errors, and message dispatching within the Rialto server component.

classes.name: GstDispatcherThread
classes.description: A class that manages a dedicated thread to handle GStreamer bus messages, including state changes and errors, for a given pipeline.

methods.name: GstDispatcherThread::GstDispatcherThread
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the dispatcher thread and starts the bus event handler thread.

methods.name: GstDispatcherThread::~GstDispatcherThread
methods.description: Destructor that signals the thread to stop and joins it.

methods.name: GstDispatcherThread::gstBusEventHandler
methods.description: Method that runs in a separate thread, processing GStreamer bus messages until deactivation.
